issues.message: Date format ambiguity detected. Dates appear as DD/MM/YYYY in source (15/03/2025, 16/03/2025, etc.) but extraction interprets as March dates. However, 23/03/2025 (discharge) would be March 23, which is only 8 days after March 15 admission - this matches stated LOS of 8 days. BUT if dates are MM/DD/YYYY, then 15/03/2025 = March 15, 16/03/2025 = March 16, 23/03/2025 = March 23 (still March). Date format appears consistent as DD/MM/YYYY based on day values >12 not present, but chronology should be verified.
issues.suggestedFix: Verify date format with source documentation. Current interpretation (DD/MM/YYYY) appears consistent with LOS calculation.

issues.message: Documentation inventory shows completenessScore: 0 (CRITICAL documentation gaps - likely unusable for discharge summary). With missing discharge summary, operative report as only document, and 0% POD coverage, this extraction should be flagged as unreliable.
issues.suggestedFix: Do not use this extraction without verifying source documents exist. Request complete medical records to fill documentation gaps.

issues.message: Documentation inventory shows only OPERATIVE_REPORT present, yet extraction contains 6 different sourceNoteTypes (ADMISSION_HP, OPERATIVE_REPORT, DISCHARGE_SUMMARY, LAB_REPORT, THERAPY_NOTE, NURSING_NOTE). This is a fundamental contradiction.
